title: Transfer | Quarry Blast Review Manifest
goal: Read quarry blast event metadata, station metadata, and waveform snippets, associate each waveform with its blast origin and recording station through ObsPy event and inventory objects, and generate `/root/blast_station_manifest.json` containing event time, station coordinates, trace start offset, duration, and channel set for analyst review.
skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on ObsPy’s event, station, and waveform object model to reconcile heterogeneous blast-monitoring assets into a single manifest. That metadata integration workflow is exactly what the shipped skill provides, without needing any other source-task skill.
